description: Source file implementing binary HTTP message parsing, encoding, and decoding for the quiche library, including request and response handling with framing, headers, and body.

classes.name: BinaryHttpMessage
classes.description: Represents a generic binary HTTP message with headers and body, supporting encoding and debugging.

classes.name: BinaryHttpMessage::Field
classes.description: Represents a header field with name and value.

classes.name: BinaryHttpMessage::Fields
classes.description: Manages a collection of header fields, supporting addition and encoding.

classes.name: BinaryHttpRequest
classes.description: Represents a binary HTTP request with control data, headers, and body, supporting creation and serialization.

classes.name: BinaryHttpResponse
classes.description: Represents a binary HTTP response with status code, headers, and body, supporting creation and serialization.

classes.name: BinaryHttpResponse::InformationalResponse
classes.description: Represents an informational response within a binary HTTP response, with headers and debug support.

methods.name: DecodeControlData
methods.description: Decodes control data (method, scheme, authority, path) from a data reader.

methods.name: DecodeFields
methods.description: Decodes header fields from a data reader, invoking a callback for each.

methods.name: DecodeFieldsAndBody
methods.description: Decodes header fields and body from a data reader into a message.

methods.name: DecodeKnownLengthRequest
methods.description: Decodes a known-length request from a data reader.

methods.name: DecodeKnownLengthResponse
methods.description: Decodes a known-length response from a data reader.

methods.name: EncodeControlData
methods.description: Encodes control data (method, scheme, authority, path) into a data writer.

methods.name: EncodeKnownLengthFieldsAndBody
methods.description: Encodes headers and body for known-length messages.

methods.name: EncodeAsKnownLength
methods.description: Serializes the request or response as a known-length message.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a BinaryHttpRequest or BinaryHttpResponse from raw data.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the message.
